Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 03-10-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the MAHE Research Assistant position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application for the Research Assistant post at MAHE is 03-10-2026. Ensure your application is sent well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Research Assistant role?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master's degree in Photonics, Physics, or Applied Physics with a first-class distinction. Prior research experience is also highly desirable.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Research Assistant position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 40,000 per month for the Research Assistant position.

faq.question: Q4. How can I apply for the Research Assistant job at MAHE?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email. You need to send your resume and relevant documents to the official email address provided in the notification.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for the MAHE Research Assistant recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the Research Assistant role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Research Assistant position at MAHE will primarily involve an interview.

faq.question: Q7. What is the job type for this Research Assistant position?
faq.answer: The Research Assistant position at MAHE is a contractual role.

faq.question: Q8. Does MAHE provide any age relaxation for reserved categories?
faq.answer: Information regarding age limits and any potential relaxation for reserved categories is not explicitly detailed here and should be confirmed in the official notification.

faq.question: Q9. What are the desirable qualifications for the Research Assistant role?
faq.answer: Prior research experience in laser and spectroscopy experiments is highly desirable, and knowledge of spectral data processing is considered an added advantage.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section of this article, under the 'Official Notification PDF' description.
